surface_owners.role: Compact eligible-profile recommendation and side-effect-free entry to preview; filtering and pagination must not duplicate the action.
Read-only profile comparison may link an authorized profile to preview; it never owns confirmation or apply.
Preserve Guided unsaved-work state and hand off a saved active profile to shared conversion review.
Preserve All settings unsaved-work and focus state and hand off a saved active profile to shared conversion review.
Preserve Monaco dirty/validation state and hand off a saved active profile to shared conversion review.

source_owners: planned:M5 shared route-owned conversion review component
surface_owners.role: One future review owner renders target selection, preview, blockers, confirmation, apply, success, and recovery for the five existing surfaces; it is not a sixth editor.

interaction_states.trigger: An active saved profile is on supported older ESR line esr-115 or esr-140; resolve the catalog recommendation target to exact latest supported artifact esr-153.0.

copy.local_consequence: This opens a conversion preview from {source_schema} to {target_schema}. Your profile will not change until you review and confirm.

accessibility.focus_behavior: Keep row or profile-context focus after eligibility refresh; activation moves focus to the shared review heading.
accessibility.keyboard_behavior: Use a native button or link in normal tab order; Enter and Space follow native semantics.

interaction_states.recovery_action: Dismiss or return to the originating surface without mutation.

interaction_states.trigger: The profile is Release, latest ESR, unknown, retired, unsaved, archived/deleted, or otherwise not an active saved supported older-ESR profile.

copy.local_consequence: Do not render a recommendation action. Preserve the profile's truthful current channel or its separate recovery state.

accessibility.focus_behavior: Removing an obsolete recommendation must not move focus; if it held focus, move focus to the profile context heading.
accessibility.keyboard_behavior: No disabled recommendation control is inserted into the tab order.

interaction_states.recovery_action: Use the state-specific recovery contract; do not infer a recommendation target.

interaction_states.trigger: An authorized user opens manual conversion for an active saved profile and selects any distinct supported/selectable exact artifact.

copy.local_consequence: Choosing a target prepares a new preview. It does not change the saved profile.

accessibility.focus_behavior: Keep focus on the selector while its status region announces preview refresh; never focus a newly inserted option.
accessibility.keyboard_behavior: Use a labeled native select or equivalent listbox with current selection and full keyboard operation.

interaction_states.recovery_action: Choose a distinct supported target or cancel review.

interaction_states.trigger: A preview request is in flight for the current saved revision and exact target.

copy.local_consequence: The saved profile is unchanged while compatibility and target validation are checked.

accessibility.focus_behavior: Keep focus on the initiating control; mark the review region busy without repeatedly announcing progress.
accessibility.keyboard_behavior: Disable duplicate preview and apply activation; keep Cancel available.

interaction_states.recovery_action: Cancel the request or wait for one terminal preview state; cancellation performs no write.

interaction_states.trigger: Preview returned applicable=true, target validation valid, and zero blockers for the exact current revision and identities.

copy.local_consequence: Review unchanged, transformed, warning, and compliance counts before confirming {source_schema} to {target_schema}.

accessibility.focus_behavior: Move focus to the preview summary heading only when the user opened review; target changes keep selector focus.
accessibility.keyboard_behavior: Counts and expandable details have semantic headings and native disclosure controls; confirmation follows them in tab order.

interaction_states.recovery_action: Change target, cancel without mutation, or continue to explicit confirmation.

interaction_states.trigger: Preview is diagnostic but applicable=false because one or more policy atoms, compliance facts, or target validation outcomes are blocked.

copy.local_consequence: The preview found {blocker_count} blocker(s). The saved profile is unchanged; resolve every blocker or choose another target.

accessibility.focus_behavior: Move focus to the blocker summary; each disclosed blocker is reachable without exposing values in DOM attributes.
accessibility.keyboard_behavior: Apply is disabled and references the blocker explanation; target selection, retry preview, and cancel remain operable.

interaction_states.recovery_action: Resolve source policy issues or choose another supported target, then request a new preview.

interaction_states.trigger: Preview cannot be produced because the operation or exact artifact is temporarily unavailable; this includes the planned ESR 115 artifact before M3 promotion.

copy.local_consequence: No profile changes were made. Retry only after the exact source and target schema artifacts are available.

accessibility.focus_behavior: Move focus to the unavailable summary and keep Retry, target selection, and Cancel next in logical order.
accessibility.keyboard_behavior: Do not expose confirmation or Apply; Retry is a native button.

interaction_states.recovery_action: Retry preview after artifact recovery, choose another target, or cancel.

interaction_states.trigger: Guided, All settings, or JSON/Monaco has browser-local unsaved work before preview or apply.

copy.local_consequence: Conversion uses the saved profile revision. Choose Save and continue, Discard and continue, or Cancel; unsaved work is never overwritten silently.

accessibility.focus_behavior: Trap focus only inside a modal decision; focus Cancel initially and restore focus to the opener on cancel.
accessibility.keyboard_behavior: Three explicitly named buttons are keyboard operable; Escape equals Cancel and performs no mutation.

interaction_states.recovery_action: Save and obtain a fresh preview, discard and obtain a fresh preview, or cancel.

interaction_states.trigger: The exact applicable preview remains current, the source is active and saved, and the user reaches the final action.

copy.local_consequence: This updates the saved schema, policy document, compliance disposition, and revision using the reviewed plan. Name, description, creation time, and archive state are preserved.

accessibility.focus_behavior: Focus the confirmation heading when opened; place Cancel before Apply in tab order and restore opener focus on cancel.
accessibility.keyboard_behavior: Apply requires one explicit activation; Enter on unrelated controls must not submit it.

interaction_states.recovery_action: Cancel without mutation or return to preview and choose another target.

interaction_states.trigger: One explicitly confirmed apply request is in flight.

copy.local_consequence: Wait for the server's atomic result. Do not close the review or submit the conversion again.

accessibility.focus_behavior: Keep focus on the disabled Apply control or move it to the progress heading if the control is removed; announce once.
accessibility.keyboard_behavior: Disable target selection, Cancel, close, and duplicate Apply until a terminal result; browser navigation uses the product's existing unload guard.

interaction_states.recovery_action: Wait for success or a recoverable failure; do not infer success from timeout or navigation.

interaction_states.trigger: Apply returns status=applied and the exact saved target revision is reloaded.

copy.local_consequence: Revision {result_revision} is saved and validated for {target_schema}. Reloaded profile state is now authoritative.

accessibility.focus_behavior: Move focus to the success heading, then offer Return to profile as the next action; restore surface focus after return.
accessibility.keyboard_behavior: Return to profile is a native link or button; no automatic redirect steals focus.

interaction_states.recovery_action: Return to the originating surface and use the exact reloaded saved state.

interaction_states.trigger: Apply fails with conversion_revision_stale because another save changed the profile revision.

copy.local_consequence: Nothing was converted. Reload the saved profile and create a new preview before applying.

accessibility.focus_behavior: Move focus to the stale-state heading; Fresh preview is the next action.
accessibility.keyboard_behavior: Old Apply remains unavailable; Fresh preview and Cancel are native controls.

interaction_states.recovery_action: Reload current saved state and request a fresh preview; never resubmit the stale digest.

interaction_states.trigger: The source identity, rederived plan, schema identity, or recipe registry differs from the reviewed preview.

copy.local_consequence: Nothing was converted. Create a fresh preview and review its validation, policy, and compliance results before confirming again.

accessibility.focus_behavior: Move focus to the changed-plan heading; invalidate and remove the old confirmation from the accessibility tree.
accessibility.keyboard_behavior: Fresh preview is the primary native action; stale Apply cannot be focused.

interaction_states.recovery_action: Request and review a fresh preview using current identities.

interaction_states.trigger: Manual preview/apply addresses a missing profile or a profile that is archived, deleted, or otherwise not active.

copy.local_consequence: No profile changes were made. Restore the archived profile first, or return to the Library if it no longer exists.

accessibility.focus_behavior: Move focus to the state heading and place Restore profile or Return to Library next.
accessibility.keyboard_behavior: Do not render Apply; recovery uses existing lifecycle controls with their own confirmation.

interaction_states.recovery_action: Restore an archived profile through its existing lifecycle flow, then create a new preview; a missing/deleted profile returns to Library.

interaction_states.trigger: The chosen target is unknown, retired, unsupported/unavailable, or its exact schema artifact cannot be loaded.

copy.local_consequence: No profile changes were made. Choose a currently supported available target and create a new preview.

accessibility.focus_behavior: Move focus to the target error, associate it with the selector, then return focus to the selector on correction.
accessibility.keyboard_behavior: Apply is absent; supported target options and Cancel remain keyboard operable.

interaction_states.recovery_action: Refresh the catalog and select a supported available exact target, then request a new preview.

interaction_states.trigger: The saved source document is invalid, its channel is unknown/retired, or its exact schema artifact is missing.

copy.local_consequence: No profile changes were made. Resolve the reported source validation or schema recovery condition before requesting another preview.

accessibility.focus_behavior: Move focus to the source error summary; validation recovery or operator guidance follows in logical order.
accessibility.keyboard_behavior: Apply remains unavailable; links back to validation use the existing focus-target contract.

interaction_states.recovery_action: Fix and save source validation errors, recover the exact source artifact, or follow operator upgrade guidance for a retired channel; then preview again.

interaction_states.trigger: Apply validation, persistence, flush, or commit fails and the API guarantees mutation=none.

copy.local_consequence: The conversion failed and no profile changes were committed. Reload the profile and create a fresh preview before retrying.

accessibility.focus_behavior: Move focus to the failure heading; Fresh preview is the next action and old Apply is removed.
accessibility.keyboard_behavior: Fresh preview and Cancel are native controls; no automatic retry.

interaction_states.recovery_action: Reload authoritative saved state and request a fresh preview; retry only after reviewing it.

interaction_states.trigger: Readiness or a profile route is blocked because stored profiles require the Alembic-owned retired-ESR upgrade; this state is admin/upgrade guidance, never a manual recommendation.

copy.primary_label: Database upgrade required for retired ESR profiles
copy.local_consequence: Profile routes remain read-only and unavailable until an administrator completes the verified backup, preflight, and database upgrade. Do not convert profiles manually.

accessibility.focus_behavior: On an operator-facing blocked route, focus the upgrade-required heading once; do not render profile-level conversion controls.
accessibility.keyboard_behavior: Any operator documentation action is a manifest-owned keyboard-reachable link; local consequence and recovery remain inline.

interaction_states.recovery_action: Administrator follows the M6 native-backup and read-only-preflight runbook; partial or failed candidates are never repaired or retried in place.
